title: Add meal-plan rename flow in detail view
description: Add a Rename action to the meal-plan detail toolbar menu with alert-based name entry, sanitisation, duplicate detection, security-scoped file handling, atomic file move, and local navigation/list refresh handling.
acceptance_criteria: MealPlanDetailView toolbar menu includes a Rename… action alongside delete.
Rename presents an alert pre-filled with the current display name minus the .menu extension.
Save is disabled until the trimmed input is non-empty.
Input is sanitised by trimming and replacing / with -.
Duplicate target names are detected before move and surface the inline duplicate error.
Successful rename performs a single moveItem(at:to:) to the new .menu URL without reparsing or rewriting contents.
The detail view URL or navigation state updates so the stale old URL is not left active, and the list view refreshes if required by existing data flow.
